verdict.rationale: Better Stack lets you create, acknowledge, and resolve incidents directly from Slack (docs-3) and receive incident alerts in Slack (docs-48), with the AI SRE agent callable from Slack or MS Teams (docs-32, docs-55). However, there's no evidence of automatic dedicated incident channel creation or role assignment within chat — only escalation policies/on-call notification (docs-39, docs-52) which is a separate mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit channel-creation-per-incident feature, role assignment inside the chat flow, and Teams-side incident declaration parity (Teams is only mentioned for alerts/AI SRE, not incident declaration).
